geometry.locator: T2K NIM paper (arXiv:1106.1238), section 3.6.1 (GPS baseline survey) and site:kamioka-mozumi-mine-super-kamiokande's own sourced coordinate
geometry.note: Not a physical structure: the beam's actual on-axis tunnel (geometry:j-parc-neutrino-beamline-tunnel) points 2.5 degrees away from this line by design, so that Super-K sees an off-axis, narrow-band neutrino spectrum. Drawn only as the first kilometres of the direction toward Super-Kamiokande, labelled 'inferred direction'.

method: Great-circle initial bearing from geometry:j-parc-neutrino-target-station's own centroid (36.4491543, 140.6042454) toward site:kamioka-mozumi-mine-super-kamiokande's sourced coordinate (36.425722, 137.310306): 270.472 degrees, computed on R = 6 371 008.8 m. Clipped to the map's extent_m (2600 m). site_id is set to site:j-parc-main-ring (the beamline's own from_site_id for its sourced baseline row) because the target station is not itself an atlas `site:` record; it sits within that same site.
name: J-PARC neutrino beam direction toward Super-Kamiokande (inferred)
notes: Computed distance from the target-station centroid to Super-Kamiokande is 294.663 km, close to (0.23% under) the T2K NIM paper's own surveyed baseline of 295.3352 km measured target-core-to-detector-centre; reported here informationally, not as a formal checks[] row (no `distance`-kind check fits two points that are, by construction, almost exactly the sourced baseline apart).

The far site is site:kamioka-mozumi-mine-super-kamiokande (Super-Kamiokande); the Hyper-Kamiokande far site (site:kamioka-hyper-kamiokande-tochibora, about 8 km further south) sees nearly the same bearing and is not drawn as a second line.

QA pass (2026-09-21): cleared an ODbL license block this inferred_direction record carried despite `osm: null` and no OSM element ever being traced -- this feature is computed entirely from two independently-sourced points (a target-station centroid and Super-Kamiokande's own surveyed coordinate), not copied/traced third-party geodata. Every sibling inferred_direction record in the atlas (geometry:cngs-direction-line, geometry:t2k-beam-direction-kamioka, geometry:fermilab-numi-direction, geometry:fermilab-lbnf-direction) correctly carries `license: null`; this one and geometry:kek-neutrino-direction-line were the only two inconsistent with that pattern.

summary.plain: The great-circle direction from J-PARC toward Super-Kamiokande, 295 km away, along which the T2K neutrino beam travels.
